transformation.original: Byte-for-byte copy of the licensed source GLB.
transformation.normalized: Production parser bakes node transforms; serialize identity nodes in authored glTF axes with float32 attributes and uint32 indices. Preserve parsed materials, embedded images, samplers and UV transforms. Unsupported or ignored source features are not added to the renderer.
transformation.subdivision: Each indexed triangle becomes four non-overlapping triangles using shared edge midpoints within its material batch; repeat twice for 16x. Interpolate positions, UVs and vertex RGBA linearly. Normalize interpolated normals at each pass, matching production normal loading. Original corners retain their normal directions; smooth shading can differ at new vertices.
transformation.precision: Float32 attribute serialization can round baked bounds. Normalized 1x is the packing control; compare each stress variant with this control as well as the original.
